data.notes: August 2026 is anchored by large electronic gatherings—Circuit Festival and Brunch Electronik—alongside strong Razzmatazz concert programming.

events.title: Circuit Festival Barcelona 2026
events.summary: Matinée Group’s Circuit Festival runs from 1 to 9 August 2026 across several Barcelona-area venues, with Ticketmaster listing 17 ticketed entries and the festival description promising 13 party events with DJs.

events.title: Brunch Electronik Festival 2026
events.summary: Brunch Electronik Festival is confirmed at Parc del Fòrum from 7 to 9 August 2026, with a large electronic lineup including Eric Prydz, Kaytranada, Jeff Mills, Paul Kalkbrenner, CamelPhat, The Blaze DJ set, I Hate Models, Floating Points live and many more.

events.title: Circuit Festival: The Main Event
events.summary: The Main Event, Circuit Festival’s large-scale Saturday night party, is confirmed for 8 August 2026 at Fira 2 Barcelona Gran Via in L’Hospitalet de Llobregat.

events.title: Circuit Festival: Water Park Day
events.summary: Circuit’s signature Water Park Day is confirmed for 4 August 2026 at Illa Fantasia in Vilassar de Dalt, with day, night and combined ticket options listed by Ticketmaster.

events.title: Bresh Open Air Poble Espanyol
events.summary: Global Latin-pop party brand Bresh takes over Poble Espanyol’s main square for a 4,500-capacity open-air edition, moving through reggaeton, Latin pop, dancehall, electronic music and old-school hits.

events.title: Afrodanz – Open Air Afro House Experience with Major League Djz
events.summary: Afrodanz returns to Seaseaclub for a Mediterranean open-air Afro House experience headlined by Major League Djz with NIIXII and Sofia Pineda.

events.title: Jackies - 9th Anniversary - Open Air Daytime w/ Hunee, Hector Romero
events.summary: Barcelona house label and touring party Jackies celebrates nine years with an open-air daytime edition led by Hunee, Hector Romero, Piem and Nesi.

events.title: SIGHT pres. Claptone, Alexanders Som, Luka Kuhnow
events.summary: SIGHT’s Sunday Barcelona party is confirmed for 2 August 2026 at Ku Barcelona, headlined by Claptone with Alexanders Som and Luka Kuhnow.

events.title: Amyl And The Sniffers
events.summary: Amyl and The Sniffers return to Barcelona for a sold-out Razzmatazz Sala 1 show on 18 August 2026.

events.title: Les Enfants goes to Seaseaclub pres. Arapu Bday Bash with Dubfire, Butch, Priku
events.summary: Les Enfants Brillants moves to Seaseaclub for Arapu’s birthday bash, pairing Arapu b2b Butch, Dubfire b2b Priku and Alex b2b Lancaster across tech-house and minimal.

events.title: Compota de Manana - MASiMAS Festival 2026
events.summary: MASiMAS Festival presents Barcelona-based Latin avant-garde group Compota de Manana at Razzmatazz Sala 2 on 29 August 2026.

events.title: Hermanos Gutierrez
events.summary: Instrumental duo Hermanos Gutierrez are confirmed for Gran Teatre del Liceu on 31 August 2026, with Ticketmaster listing an 20:30 start time.

events.title: SUMMER INDOOR RAVE with Don Woezik & Per Pleks
events.summary: INPUT’s summer indoor rave pairs Don Woezik and Per Pleks for a hard-driving techno night in one of Barcelona’s key club rooms.

events.title: SIGHT & Vagalum pres. Sonny Fodera
events.summary: SIGHT teams with Vagalum for a Ku Barcelona Sunday edition headlined by tech-house mainstay Sonny Fodera.

events.title: SIGHT & Valhalla pres. Korolova, Prophecy, JP Candela, Rivellino
events.summary: SIGHT links with Valhalla at Ku Barcelona for a melodic house and tech-house Sunday led by Korolova with Prophecy, JP Candela and Rivellino.

events.title: SIGHT pres. James Hype, Alex Now, La Cintia
events.summary: SIGHT’s weekly Ku Barcelona residency brings UK house act James Hype with Alex Now and La Cintia.

events.title: Black Label Society UK / EU Tour 2026
events.summary: Black Label Society plays Razzmatazz on 4 August 2026, with Thundermother and Thrown Into Exile confirmed as support acts.

events.title: Hunee with Piem, Hector Romero and Nesi
events.summary: Hunee is listed for an open-air La Terrrazza date on 8 August 2026, joined by Piem, Hector Romero and Nesi.

events.title: Happy Techno at La Terrrazza Barcelona - Open Air / Daytime
events.summary: Happy Techno’s open-air daytime edition at La Terrrazza is confirmed for 1 August 2026, with Stefano Noferini, Lexlay, Cris Ocaña and Shitake listed on the lineup.

events.title: High On Fire - European Tour Summer 2026
events.summary: Grammy-winning metal band High On Fire is confirmed for Razzmatazz Sala 2 on 5 August 2026 as part of its European Tour Summer 2026.
